about_the_game:
What exactly is Vault of the Vanquished?

Vault of the Vanquished is a rogue-like adventure where you have been sent to the afterlife, after you were killed by the kings orders. You have now been resurrected and now you can collect and unlock hundreds of cards, to vanquish as many enemies as possible and bring peace to your Kingdom.

This game is built on the idea of RNG, bringing you through countless completely randomized encounters to 100s of items you can unveil to use in your run! Push to Vanquish enough enemies to fight the boss of each zone, cleansing them one by one, and bringing peace to the Kingdom.

Everything in the game now!

  • 15 25 Items!

  • 1 Playable Characters! (Bruiser)

  • 1 Complete Stage!

Here's What's Coming to the Game

  • Plague Doctor (Character)

  • Medic (Character)

  • Custom Item Creation!

  • Custom Arena Creation!

  • Custom Enemy Creation!

  • Steam Workshop!

content_descriptors.notes: This game just depicts occasional themes like suicide, abuse and drugs when it comes to the name of some items, but nothing is acted on in-game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1650 GTX 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: NVIDIA High Definition Audio
  • Additional Notes: Might run on lower spec hardwear, this is just what I had to test Minimum System Requirements.
